3. Notes：下面 7 則，各自定時在那一天的台灣 21:00（一天一則）：
12/8（二）：We built five animated templates without GSAP or any library. CSS scroll-driven animations + the Web Animations API cover almost everything now.
12/9（三）：Rule for every animated template: if a visitor turns on "reduce motion", every animation switches off and the content is simply there.
12/10（四）：`animation-timeline: view()` is the most useful CSS property I've learned this year. Scroll reveals with zero JavaScript.
12/11（五）：Nothing should be hidden behind an animation. With JavaScript off, every section of our templates is still visible and every button works.
12/12（六）：A shader background can be a few dozen lines of plain WebGL. No library, nothing to update, nothing to license.
12/13（日）：Animate transform and opacity only. Anything else causes layout shift, and on a cheap phone you can feel it.
12/14（一）：If a browser doesn't support scroll-driven animations, elements just appear without the effect. For a business website that's the right way to fail.

這是 Polyglot Pages 的每週一檢討，照 sales/80萬計畫.md「每週一檢討」：看聯絡數、回覆數、成交數、收入、Care 訂閱數，跟計畫目標差多少；再照 7 件事（價格、留存、每家多收、產能、管道、提早、時間效率）至少提 1 個附估計的建議，標成「建議（待使用者決定）」。也看「80 萬之後」的觸發條件有沒有到。
